_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (±2pt in only 7% of windows) plus diverging mini-top factors favor holding the ladder rung or one step down without a directional price call until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase or direction
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G stays 47-54 and funding/ETF flows remain flat while 30d momentum does not accelerate
next_move.invalidated_if: skew/dvol stay pinned at extremes and price gives back the 30d gain, or funding plus ETF flows surge and F&G clears 55
